page_feature_count_note: Dataset page header says '# Features 6' while the variables table lists 8 columns; the file itself is authoritative (8 columns verified).

top_20_selection.rule: revenue-ranked over the 52 full weeks; demand in >= 30/52 weeks

replaced.description: DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN

backtest.seasonal_naive_note: Seasonal naive is unavailable on both backtest origins (y(t-52) does not exist for a 52-week series); it falls back to naive, its WAPE is n/a and it never contends for winner selection.

reorder_assumptions.safety_stock_formula: SS = z * sigma * sqrt(lead time in weeks)
reorder_assumptions.sigma_window: training weeks 1-48; non-zero weeks only for intermittent/lumpy
reorder_assumptions.on_hand_assumption: zero on-hand; order-up-to level S is the deliverable
reorder_assumptions.forecast: 4-week trend extrapolation from one retailer, one year — NOT a seasonal prediction
